purpose: Apply S28/S29 to the real Mission Control Adaptive Skills execution-record adapter boundary, where cross-repository skill records become read-only web UI evidence.

usage_observation.notes: S28 framed Adaptive Skills execution-record fields as cross-repository evidence, not instructions. S29 framed Mission Control as a web UI projection boundary that displays sourced data without becoming an authority. The work added a regression test for prompt-like record content while preserving the existing governance_authority rejection.

gaps.gap: The adapter already rejects governance authority claims, but lacked an explicit prompt-like content regression test.
Repeated real S28/S29 usage evidence is still limited to two records after S36 and S38; this is not enough to justify scanners, policy engines, enforcement or pack expansion.

decision.rationale: S28/S29 were useful for a real Mission Control adapter review and justified a focused regression test, but the evidence supports only continued advisory use and future capture.

used_for: classifying Adaptive Skills execution-record fields as external/cross-repository evidence rather than instructions
checking that prompt-like record text cannot change the adapter's authority interpretation
preserving explicit rejection of records that claim Mission Control governance authority
did_not_do: treat external record text as policy authority

used_for: reviewing Mission Control as a public/read-only web projection of sourced records
checking that source refs and execution context remain displayed evidence, not decisions
confirming no auth, tenant, secret, API or state-changing behavior was added
did_not_do: claim React rendering is a complete security proof

reviewed_boundary.boundary_name: Adaptive Skills execution record -> Mission Control Resource Observatory signal
reviewed_boundary.authority_posture: Adaptive Skills records are trace evidence only; AletheIA retains gate and decision authority.

expansion_decision.rationale: S38 is real usage evidence and resolved one local regression-test gap, but it does not justify new packs, schemas, scanners, dashboards, policy engines or runtime enforcement.
expansion_decision.next_safe_step: Keep capturing future real S28/S29 usage with the S35 template when S37 criteria are met.
